summary: Ambassadors / Referrals feature validated end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_referrals.py — 16/16 pytest cases PASS across 6 classes covering (1) register with ref (valid attribution, bogus silent-ignore, self-ref safeguard, duplicate email 409 + counter integrity), (2) session-referral path via direct Mongo injection (mirroring what /auth/session does), (3) referral confirmation on FIRST lesson (valid+1 / pending-1 / referral_events promoted / referral_counted + first_activity_at set), 2nd lesson guard (no double-count), 3 invitees → embajador_digital badge, 10 invitees → embajador_oro badge, (4) GET /referrals/mine shape (valid, pending, next_goal, goals[thresholds 3+10], share_url includes ref=+code=, poster_url, invitees list ≤20 with first-name-only), 401 without auth, (5) poster.png with PNG magic \x89PNG, size > 5KB, Content-Disposition inline filename containing user_id, 401 without auth, (6) /api/join public HTML with inviter name + school name + Abrir CTA, still renders school-only when ref missing. Frontend E2E via Expo web preview @ https://ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com (mobile viewport 390×844): Profile /profile renders AmbassadorsCard with all 3 stats (Confirmados/Pendientes/Para insignia), progress bar, 2 goal pills (🥉 3, 🥇 10), primary CTA "Invitar a mi escuela", "Copiar link" (label toggles to "¡Copiado!" on tap → clipboard confirmed) and "Ver póster" (modal opens with poster-close + poster-share testIDs, close dismisses the modal). After seeding 1 valid + 2 pending invitees via API, the card correctly shows 1 / 2 / 2 for goal 3 and lists first-name-only entries with correct "Pendiente" (amber) / "Confirmado" (green) pills. 2 real bugs found — see below (both are business-logic issues left for the main agent).

ui_bugs.issue: Image inside the "Ver póster" modal renders a broken image on web: /api/referrals/poster.png requires Bearer auth and tags cannot inject Authorization headers. Console shows a 401 for the image request. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AmbassadorsCard.tsx:210-214 uses without a signed / query-token URL. Backend endpoint at /app/backend/server.py:1443 hard-gates poster on Bearer token.

integration_issues.issue: captureIncomingReferral stores a GARBLED value (e.g. 'user_0513bd38aefb https://ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com/?ref=user_0513bd38aefb') in localStorage/AsyncStorage under 'hackseguro.pending_ref'. Downstream, POST /auth/register receives that string as ref → backend user lookup fails → invitee.invited_by_user_id stays null (silent ignore). The entire cold-start referral attribution flow is broken on web. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/referrals.ts:27 builds raw = hash + ' ' + search + ' ' + href and parseParam uses regex `[?#&]${key}=([^&#]+)` which does NOT exclude whitespace, so the capture group swallows everything up to the next '&' or '#'. Fix: either tighten the regex to `[?#&]${key}=([^&#\s]+)` OR parse each of location.hash / location.search / location.href separately (recommended). Reproduced end-to-end: after ?ref=<real inviter id>, pending_ref = '<real> https://...' → register(ref=<garbled>) → /auth/me → invited_by_user_id = null.

issues: Cosmetic RN-web console warnings (unchanged from iter5): shadow* deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated.

Suggested: replace the concatenated raw with sequential lookups in [window.location.search, window.location.hash, window.location.href] and use a tighter regex `[?#&]ref=([^&#\s]+)`. Add a unit test that captureIncomingReferral() from a URL like `/?ref=user_ABC` writes exactly `user_ABC`.

HIGH — Make the ambassadors poster viewable on web: either (a) accept `?token=<session_token>` as an alternative auth path on GET /api/referrals/poster.png, or (b) embed the poster as base64 in the /referrals/mine response, or (c) generate a short-lived signed URL. Currently the modal shows a broken image on the web preview.
LOW — Consider extracting AmbassadorsCard.tsx (386 lines) into card + modal sub-components for readability (not a blocker).
critical_code_review_comments: _attach_inviter (server.py:306-337) correctly guards against: null ref, self-ref (ref == user_id), unknown inviter, invitee already attributed. Idempotent — verified by test_a_valid_ref_sets_attribution + test_c_self_referral_is_ignored + test_d_duplicate_email_does_not_double_bump.

_maybe_confirm_referral (server.py:340-390) atomically flips referral_counted=true, decrements inviter.referrals_pending, increments referrals_valid, promotes referral_events.status → valid with confirmed_at, and unlocks badges at 3/10 thresholds. Called from both /lessons/complete (server.py:757) and /games/complete (server.py:784). Verified with test_b_second_lesson_does_not_double_count (guarded by $ne True) and test_c/d badge unlocks.

GET /referrals/mine paginates events limit=20 and joins invitee display via a single find $in query (no N+1). First-name split is done server-side (server.py:1412) — confirmed by test_invitees_cap_at_20_and_first_name_only.
Poster PNG generation (server.py:1277-1330 + call at 1450) returns image/png with Content-Disposition inline. PNG bytes start with \x89PNG. Size verified > 5KB.
/api/join public HTML correctly injects inviter first name AND school name AND a deep-link CTA. Missing ref still renders the school block only.

BUG — /app/frontend/src/referrals.ts parseParam regex is too permissive (`[^&#]+`); combined with the space-joined raw string in captureIncomingReferral(), it captures URL trailing text into the pending_ref. Blocks the described cold-start attribution path.
BUG — in AmbassadorsCard renders a broken image on web because the poster endpoint requires a Bearer token that requests cannot include.

Public URL: https://ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com. Profile screen: /profile. All ambassadors testIDs verified present: ambassadors-card, referrals-valid, referrals-pending, invite-share-button, invite-copy-button, invite-poster-button, poster-close, poster-share. To re-verify the cold-start capture bug once fixed, open `?ref=user_XXXXXX` in the web preview, then evaluate `localStorage.getItem('hackseguro.pending_ref')` — it must equal exactly `"user_XXXXXX"` (with quotes because AsyncStorage-web JSON-stringifies). Note that AsyncStorage on web ends up in localStorage (not IndexedDB), so `localStorage.getItem(...)` is the right assertion. Direct Mongo helpers live in /app/backend/tests/_smoke_referrals.py and /app/backend/tests/test_referrals.py.
rca_of_issue: BUG #1 (ref-capture garbled): /app/frontend/src/referrals.ts:27 concatenates location.hash + ' ' + location.search + ' ' + location.href into one blob. parseParam uses `[?#&]${key}=([^&#]+)` — the character class does not include whitespace, so the regex greedily eats everything from `?ref=` until the next `&` or `#`. Because the same query is repeated in `search` and `href`, the captured value ends up being e.g. `user_0513bd38aefb https://ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com/?ref=user_0513bd38aefb`. Mitigation: (a) tighten regex to `[?#&]${key}=([^&#\s]+)`, and/or (b) parse search/hash/href separately and return the first hit. Simple 3-line patch. BUG #2 (poster 401 on web): backend `/api/referrals/poster.png` hard-requires Authorization: Bearer . React-Native-Web `Image` maps to `` which cannot inject that header. Options: accept `?token=` query alternative in the endpoint, or return the PNG bytes as base64 inside /referrals/mine, or issue a short-lived signed URL.
